# SPD-052 — Headless hook probes copy the launcher without its program

## Brief
tests/probes/headless.py (SPD-008, SPD-015, SPD-018 scenarios) builds its scratch home by copying bin/spud alone; since SPD-016 bin/spud is a launcher that loads spud_ledger.py from beside its real path, so every scenario there should fail at 'spud init' until the script also copies bin/spud_ledger.py (as tests/probes/headless_projects.py does).

Evidence: build_home in tests/probes/headless.py at HEAD: shutil.copy2(SPUD, home / 'bin' / 'spud') and no copy of bin/spud_ledger.py; bin/spud load() reads os.path.join(dirname(realpath(__file__)), 'spud_ledger.py'). Not run to confirm, since it is outside SPD-014.
